mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have clear skies at Fireman's Park and a beautiful waxing gibbous moon overhead.

City offices will be closed for the Thanksgiving holiday on November 26 and 27, meaning refuse and recycling collections will be pushed to Friday. Additionally, the city is evaluating space needs for our Public Works and Utilities department to ensure we continue to provide top-tier services as our population expands.

There is a lot to do in town, starting with live music today at Bailey's Run and Paddy Mac's. Tomorrow, check out the music at Wisconsin Brewing Company, followed by Yoga at Insight Wellness on November 23 and a full slate of trivia nights starting November 25.
On November 9, an officer observed a vehicle swerving on U S H 18/151 and conducted a traffic stop, resulting in an O W I arrest for the driver, who was a 61-year-old man.
Satisfy your sweet tooth with today's flavor of the day, Crazy for Cookie Dough, and be sure to stop by when the doors open today at 10:00 AM.
